plugins.name: Torrent Downloader
plugins.description: Downloads every episode missing from a TV or anime library and hands it to the encoder.
plugins.author: NoMercy Community

versions.changelog: Two things that were wrong for as long as the plugin was working: the pages flickered while anything was downloading, and a browser could outlive the server that started it.

Every page is the same shell again. Shows, Queue, Downloads, History, Skipped, Sources and Settings were drawn in half the width with a dead pane beside them and their last column cut off; only the dashboard was right.
Keeps a TV or anime library complete by downloading missing episodes over BitTorrent and handing each one to the server's own encoder.
